items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: talk to her and ask her to sit down.

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, I'm trying to think. A girl -- oh, Bert Williams' niece, Lottie Tyler, she told me about Billie Holiday. She said, 'There's a girl that sings at a little club here at 133rd,' and she says, 'I want you to hear her.' And I went there to hear her, and I just was so carried away with her work, you know. And I used to go in and

talk to her and ask her to sit down. I never did drink anything but lemonade or Coca-Cola or something, you know, but I don't remember Billie drinking. I think she had lemonade all the time. I don't think she drank anything. Stop picking your face. You'll pick it -- shame on you.
Okay. But she was very young then. She was a teenager, wasn't she?
